title: UTRA RoboSoccer Model Schema
description: Schema for model/robot_model.yaml. This file is THE source of truth; URDF, MJCF, ros2_control configuration, the safety manifest, and the firmware joint table are all generated siblings and are never inputs. Draft 2020-12. NOTE: no `default` keyword appears anywhere in this schema. A default is a silent value, and every silent value in this pipeline is a defect.

identifier.description: Lower snake_case. Used verbatim as a URDF/MJCF name and as a C identifier in the generated firmware joint table.

inertia.description: Inertia tensor about the link's centre of mass (`com_m`), with axes parallel to the link frame: the form CAD exports, and the one URDF and MJCF `fullinertia` take. The products are tensor elements (ixy = -integral of x*y dm); some CAD tools report the product of inertia (+integral of x*y dm), which has the opposite sign. Validator checks M-01/M-02 reject a tensor no rigid body can have.

parent_joint.description: Null for exactly one link, the root. Validator check K-01.

mass_kg.description: Best estimate: weighed once the part exists, CAD before. Mass, COM, and inertia describe one body, so a weighed mass that replaces a CAD one scales the CAD inertia by the same ratio unless the inertia is re-derived.

com_m.description: Centre of mass in this link's frame.

visual_mesh.description: Mesh name, resolved against the robot's `assets_dir` in model/robots.yaml. Null is permitted; a missing key is not.

dimensions_m.description: MJCF-native: sphere [r]; cylinder/capsule [r, half_len]; box half-extents [x/2, y/2, z/2]. URDF emitters must double box dimensions.

axis.description: Unit vector in the joint frame; positive motion follows the right-hand rule about it. Validator check K-02 enforces the unit norm, so a typo is rejected rather than normalised into a different axis.

effort_peak_duration_s.description: A peak torque without a duration is unusable. Required, never null.

direction_sign.description: Relates the motor's encoder angle to this joint's angle: joint = direction_sign * (motor - zero_offset_rad). A property of how the motor is mounted, so it lives here and not in `axis`: flipping the axis instead would change the joint-space convention every controller and policy depends on.

calibration.description: Joint zero offsets are the only calibration class in the ADR-002 startup interlock, because a zero error shifts the entire SafetyKernel envelope.

zero_offset_rad.description: Motor encoder angle at this joint's zero. Depends on how the motor was assembled into the joint, so it belongs to the joint, not the motor. Null for a robot with no hardware.

actuator.description: Name of an entry in `actuators`. Null only for `fixed` joints. Validator check A-01.

motor_class.description: A motor model in model/motors.yaml, whose drive limits this actuator has, or PROVISIONAL for a simulated actuator with none. Validator check A-06.

bus_segment.description: Feeds the HW-13 per-segment utilisation arithmetic.

can_node_id.description: 29-bit extended identifier space. Free-form; uniqueness of (bus_segment, can_node_id) is validator check A-02.

slot.description: Explicit 0-based order of this motor within its bus_segment. Not derived from can_node_id. The STM32 transport's `motor` index. Validator checks (bus_segment, slot) uniqueness and 0..n-1 contiguity per segment.

default_kp.description: Hold stiffness for this joint, within its motor model's kp_max (A-04). A per-joint value because it depends on the load the motor drives.

default_kd.description: Hold damping for this joint, within its motor model's kd_max (A-04).

imu.description: Optional. The one inertial sensor the robot carries, mounted on `link`. Emitted as an MJCF site with gyro, accelerometer and frame-orientation sensors, a URDF frame `<name>_link`, and a ros2_control sensor `<name>` exporting orientation, angular_velocity and linear_acceleration.

pos_m.description: Sensor origin in the frame of `link`.

quat_wxyz.description: Sensor orientation in the frame of `link`, w first. Must normalise to 1; validator check S-01.
